name: collector.upgrade
description: Upgrade the server's Heimdall collector to a newer signed release, using the collector's own upgrade command, and optionally turn on its tripwire reports. It checks the release's Sigstore signature, keeps the hub URL and token, and refuses a downgrade. There is no automatic rollback: a failed upgrade can stop the server's reports to Heimdall until someone runs it again.

tripwires.description: on: also turn on the collector's tripwire reports (heimdall-collect upgrade --tripwires; collector v0.5.34 or later). Left out, the server keeps its current choice.

health_check: The helper checks that the installed collector reports the new version.
